entries.label: In lieu of a required cover letter, please describe why you are interested in interning at Hudl in 2-5 sentences.
entries.value: Most of what I've built has been for people who actually use it, which is why Hudl interests me: coaches and athletes notice immediately when video, stats, or a workflow breaks. When I shipped ClarityAtlas, an iOS health app, into a live Johns Hopkins pilot with 30+ users, I learned that the hard part was not the model or the Swift code but making passive sleep and motion estimates trustworthy enough that someone would change a decision based on them, and I think analysis tools for sports sit in the same place. I also like the kind of technical problems your product implies, since I've worked on temporal sequence modeling and alert ranking over event streams for an anomaly-detection system, and turning noisy signals into something a person can act on is the work I want more of. Your posting says interns are trusted to get work done their own way, and I'm looking for a team where I can own a real piece of a system rather than isolated tickets.
